what: Pre-launch prerequisites for the zero-shot dyn retrain (docs/acceptance/zero_shot_retrain_REGISTERED.md)
blocked_on: user decision on the outbound transfer route; registration makes it a precondition

code_identity.note: read from the code_identity field of the 23 Miami rows, not assumed. model/ is uniformly i/lf, so the mixed-line-ending hazard is absent.

training_identities_post_draw.note: computed with the loader's own select_validation_users, i.e. POST-draw, not the pre-draw pool. BOXRR users/ holds 4021 entries but 4020 directories - the extra is CITATION.txt, which the loader skips via os.path.isdir. The inventory command in CLAUDE.md uses `ls | wc -l` and therefore over-counts by one on any corpus carrying a citation file.

sample_cache.note: matches the original arm's sample_time=10, sample_rate=20, channels=full, resample=nearest, window_stride=5. Index build is a cache hit, not a CSV reparse.

paths_exercised: validation draw (72 held out; 204 training classes)
CROSS-CORPUS evaluate() on an unseen corpus via eval_normalize=target_fit
paths_NOT_exercised: scoring on CrossApplicationXR_Dataset, which this node does not hold - ViewGauss stood in as the unseen corpus
the full 4096-identity index build (memory not yet measured at full scale)
smoke_run.note: This DID execute the evaluation path. The last Rack gate drove training_step in a manual loop and never ran validation, then crashed at minute 22 - stating which path a gate exercised is the point of this field.

UNREGISTERED_AXES_FOUND.why_it_matters: The registration names device, numpy and pair draw. torch is a four-minor DOWNGRADE in the library that owns the cuDNN BiLSTM kernel this arm trains. CLAUDE.md prices that kernel at up to 7e-4 AUC BETWEEN DEVICES; between torch versions it is unmeasured here. Registered now, before the run, so it cannot be reached for afterwards - which is the registration's own stated reason for naming the other three.
